muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is perfect-aware alpha-beta for 4-in-a-row on 4x4. Immediate wins are taken and immediate losses are blocked. Otherwise iterative-deepening minimax with alpha-beta from the point of view of player 1 is used under ~0.9s. Terminal wins are scored as +-100000 with depth preference for faster wins, non-terminal leaves are scored by line potentials where 3-in-a-row is a huge threat, 2-in-a-row medium and 1 small with defense weighted higher. Move ordering is center-first then corners then edges, reordered by previous iteration scores to maximize pruning, win-check only examines lines through the last move, and any timeout falls back to the best completed depth and finally to a 1-ply heuristic, guaranteeing a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is perfect play for 4-in-a-row on 4x4 with time control: instant win, instant single block, then iterative deepening alpha-beta with move ordering and heuristic evaluation. All 10 winning lines are used for win detection and for scoring open lines with 3-2-1 weights plus centre control. Moves are ordered by static position value plus adjacency to stones to improve pruning. Search is maximizing for 1 with faster wins preferred, minimizing for -1, with timeout checks and best-move fallback to guarantee a legal move within 1s. Empty board opens in the centre.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is perfect-play search for 4-in-a-row on 4x4. Immediate win is taken, immediate loss is blocked, otherwise iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta from the player-to-move perspective is used. Bitboards and win-masks make win-check and evaluation fast, center-first ordering plus winning-move-first ordering gives strong pruning, evaluation counts open lines with exponential weights for 2 and 3 in a row, and time control guarantees a legal move within 1s with center opening book.
muse_spark_1.3/004: Strategy is optimal 4-in-a-row play with bitboards, immediate win/block, iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta, transposition table and symmetric line evaluation. Center-first ordering, time-limited to <1s with safe fallback to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is perfect play for 4-in-a-row on 4x4 with time control: instant win, instant block, then iterative deepening negamax with alpha-beta, transposition table and central move ordering. Evaluation counts open lines with exponential weights for 1/2/3 in a row plus positional weights, exact win/loss detection prefers faster wins. Search is capped at ~0.9s and always falls back to a legal move.
